bullets.bullet_text: Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs for regulated financial institutions, architecting traceable scenario governance and model-risk remediation frameworks that anchored enterprise-wide regulatory reporting portfolios.

Led quantitative derivatives and variable-annuity hedging engagements for insurance capital management, applying exotic pricing, liability Greek stress-testing, and hedge design to strengthen actuarial-grade decision infrastructure.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics that underpin scalable data-platform governance.
